Messages.Author: ShanDow
Messages.Body:
I know Imbued aren't well liked around here, and most people would like to pretend they don't exist, but have noticed something while parsing.

Vision and Visceratika share the same discipline code of 'vis'.

Internally I've been replacing Vision's use with 'vsn' to avoid clashes, also added the columns for their disciplines as well.

Is this of any use to anyone else?

Messages.Author: ShanDow
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
This is because the printed version don't have them. The accents on those cards are only present in the Revised version of the CSV which is in progress and hasn't been updated recently on the website.

Messages.Author: ShanDow
Messages.Body:
I just checked my code history, at some point for reasons unknown to me now ( maybe this was the version that some wording was cleaned up in... ) I had used the revised csv as my base data, which does have the accented names.

I had just noticed Carlton Van Wyk had the "( Hunter )" part dropped, which got me looking at other name changes just to check

If revised is meant to be a work in progress, I'll leave it off my list for the time being, and stick with the standard UTF-8 csv

Sorry to be a pain, I appreciate all the work you do.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
No worry, there could have been some loopholes. The "(Hunter)" on Carlton was dropped because it has a pseudo-purpose that has always been unclear (especially on Bane Mummies). Long ago, it was used to indicate the ally type, but now that piece of information has moved to the textbox, so it's no longer required. Other allies will be updated accordingly.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
